title: ICC tells prosecution to trim witnesses in Duterte case

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III on Wednesday told the prosecution to consider reducing its number of witnesses against former President Rodrigo Duterte “to conclude the case as quickly as possible.” Presiding Judge Joanna Korner made the suggestion during the third status conference in the case after prosecutors sought 193 hours to present their case. “You may want to think about whether it is possible to reduce the number of witnesses,” said Korner, noting how the prosecution also has four experts on the same topic. “…it really is important, even more important than normal, that we […]...
